email.body1:
Colin, saw Orum ship the new AI Dialer alongside role-play simulations and automated scorecards.

Shipping fast usually means more in-market accounts than the global team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Orum off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Colin, quick follow-up for Orum.

With new product velocity, the global number usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams can't say how many meetings they need to book to hit target across regions, so coverage gaps surface late and the quarter slips.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Orum needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Colin, last bit of proof for Orum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Orum's reply rate likely compares to other sales-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Colin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling global pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running global sales is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Orum either way.
